source_title: 21st U’khand State Science and Technology Congress begins in Doon - The Times of India
source_excerpt: Dehradun: The 21st Uttarakhand State Science and Technology Congress (USSTC-2026) was inaugurated at Science City in Dehradun on Sunday. Organised by the Uttarakhand State Council for Science and Technology (UCOST), the event focuses on addressing regional and national challenges through scientific research, innovation and sustainable approaches.Uttarakhand chief minister Pushkar Singh Dhami addressed the gathering through a video message during the inaugural session. On the first day, participants presented over 260 research papers across 13 technical divisions covering areas such as biotechnology, environmental science, emerging technologies and health sciences.The congress featured a special brainstorming session titled âSTI Policy: Developed India, Empowered Uttarakhand 2047â.
